chunks: From him, from his father, from Hammad, from Hareez, from Zurara, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him), who said:

Do not be careless with your salat, for the Prophet (may Allah's blessings be upon him and his family) said at the time of his passing: 'He is not of me, the one who belittles his salat; he is not of me, the one who drinks an intoxicant. He will not come to me at the Fountain — no, by Allah.'

key_terms.اسْتَخَفَّ: To belittle or treat lightly — the sin is not mere forgetfulness but deliberate disregard
key_terms.الْحَوْضَ: The Hawd (Fountain/Pool) — the eschatological pool of al-Kawthar at which the Prophet will receive his followers on the Day of Resurrection
key_terms.لَا تَتَهَاوَنْ: Do not be careless/negligent — an imperative prohibition conveying serious gravity
key_terms.لَيْسَ مِنِّي: Is not of me — prophetic disownment, the strongest form of condemnation in hadith literature

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet say about neglecting salat and drinking alcohol on his deathbed?
ai.summary: Imam al-Baqir (AS) transmits a dying declaration of the Prophet (SAWW) disowning those who neglect salat or consume intoxicants, invoking the eschatological imagery of the Fountain (Hawd al-Kawthar) on the Day of Resurrection. The hadith is reported through the distinguished companion Zurara ibn A'yan, one of the most trusted narrators from Imam al-Baqir. The gravity of the declaration is underscored by its context — the final moments of the Prophet's life — and sealed with a solemn oath 'by Allah,' conveying that such persons will be excluded from intercession at the Fountain.

en.hubeali:
From him, from his father, from Hammad, from Hareyz, from Zurara, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘Do not be careless with your Salāt, for the Prophetsaww said during hissaww passing away: ‘He is not from mesaww, the one who belittles with his Salāt; he is not from mesaww, the one who drinks an intoxicant. He would not be returning to measws at the Fountain, no by Allahazwj, (he won’t)’.
en.sarwar: 7. It is a narration from him (narrator of previous Hadith) by his father from Hammad from Hariz from Zurarah who has said the following: “Abu Ja’far, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said,

‘You must not consider your Salah (prayer) insignificant; the Holy Prophet said when he was about to pass away, “Those who consider their Salah (prayer) insignificant are not of my people, as well as those who drink intoxicating liquor. They will not be able to come to me at the pond of al-Kawthar, no by Allah (they will not be able to do so).””’
